text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":32,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"32 forwards"},{"id":"q2","value":80,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"80 guards"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"divide guards (80) by forwards (32) to begin the Euclidean process for finding the greatest common factor"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q1"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply that quotient back by 32 to find the largest multiple of 32 not exceeding 80"},{"op":"sub","args":["q2","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract to get the remainder, continuing the Euclidean algorithm"},{"op":"div","args":["q1","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"divide forwards (32) by that remainder to continue narrowing to the greatest common factor"},{"op":"mul","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"multiply the quotient back by the remainder"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"subtract to check the final remainder is zero, confirming the greatest common factor -- the greatest number of teams"},{"op":"div","args":["q2","s3"],"out":"s7","note":"divide total guards (80) by the greatest common factor (the number of teams) to find how many guards are on each team"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"guards on each team"},"dismissed":[]}
